question: Are there elements, other than pitch, that can potentially result in out of key converted singing?
title: PitchNet: Unsupervised Singing Voice Conversion with Pitch Adversarial Network
answer_rationale: Text 1 and Text 8 indicate that input pitch can affect the output singing voice, and Text 9 shows that pitch tracking and comparison are used to evaluate pitch accuracy. This implies that elements other than pitch, such as the singer's timbre or phonetic representation, can also contribute to out-of-key conversion, as the models struggle with joint phonetic and pitch representation (Text 4, Text 6).
